task.task_unarchived: restored the task from the archive

notes.note_file_attached: attached the file "{name}" to a note

finance.recurrence_end_date_changed: changed the end date of the recurrence

setlist.song_added: added the song "{title}" to the repertoire
setlist.song_archived: removed the song "{title}" from the repertoire
setlist.songs_archived_one: archived a song from the repertoire
setlist.song_unarchived: brought the song "{title}" back into the repertoire
setlist.song_file_attached: attached the file "{name}" to a song
setlist.song_file_detached: detached the file "{name}" from a song
setlist.lyrics_added_for_song: wrote the lyrics "{title}" for the song "{song}"
setlist.lyrics_archived: moved the lyrics "{title}" to the bin
setlist.lyrics_linked: linked the lyrics "{title}" to the song "{song}"
setlist.lyrics_unlinked: unlinked the lyrics "{title}" from the song "{song}"
setlist.setlist_item_added_untitled: added a song to a setlist
setlist.setlist_items_added_one: added a song to the setlist "{name}"
setlist.setlist_item_removed: removed a song from a setlist
setlist.setlist_item_reordered_count: reordered the {count} songs of a setlist
setlist.setlist_item_reordered: reordered the songs of a setlist
setlist.setlist_item_updated: edited a song in a setlist
setlist.setlist_file_attached: attached the file "{name}" to a setlist
setlist.setlist_file_detached: detached the file "{name}" from a setlist

rider.rider_item_added: added the section "{title}" to the tech rider "{rider}"
rider.rider_item_renamed: renamed a section of the tech rider "{rider}" to "{title}"
rider.rider_item_updated: edited the section "{title}" of the tech rider "{rider}"
rider.rider_item_removed: deleted the section "{title}" from the tech rider "{rider}"
rider.rider_item_reordered_count: reordered the {count} sections of the tech rider "{rider}"
rider.rider_item_reordered: reordered the sections of the tech rider "{rider}"
rider.rider_stage_plot_updated: updated the stage plot "{title}" of the tech rider "{rider}" ({count} items)
rider.rider_patch_list_updated: updated the input list "{title}" of the tech rider "{rider}" ({inputs} inputs, {outputs} monitors)

settings.band_renamed: renamed the Band Space from "{from}" to "{to}"
settings.member_role_changed: changed the role of {member} from {from} to {to}
settings.member_profile_updated: updated the stage name and instruments of {member}
settings.deletion_scheduled_for: scheduled the Band Space for deletion on {date}
settings.deletion_scheduled: scheduled the Band Space for deletion
settings.deletion_cancelled: cancelled the deletion of the Band Space

unknown: performed the action "{type}" in the {module} module
